phoneUIExclusion.embeddingBottomStatus: Inferred from the nominal1080x1920 aspect ratio and occluded by footer UI; not a measured clean-content bottom.
phoneUIExclusion.exclusionPolicy: Conservative masks may remove valid map pixels. Masked or occluded pixels are unknown and must not count as terrain, color or frontier failures.

fullTimeline.observation: The whole peninsula is visible, with orange northern territory and textured purple southern territory. Support badges enter or reposition during the opening framing change. Gold outer-edge light is already visible.
National marker groups arrange on both sides while the camera gradually tracks and changes scale. The original purple territory remains textured; new gain is not yet dominant.

A highly saturated violet gained band advances north with a thin white leading interface. Gold outer-country and coastline light remains a separate visual role. Camera tracking and scale change continue.
The bright gained band broadens while the original southern purple retains texture. Remaining orange territory recedes. No replay of the opening is observed.
A yellow and black warning or radiation-style glyph appears near the front. It is an authored story symbol, not proof of a physical simulation.

Aircraft silhouettes traverse the view. A short localized orange and white impact effect, then a grey remnant, appear near one position. This later story beat is outside the existing five-second scene.
Aircraft leave; marker groups and northward control advance remain. No reset to the opening state is observed.
Remaining orange territory shrinks. Some northern markers fade individually while bright purple gains fill the north and camera tracking continues.
A large red, blue and white flag-shaped fill replaces most territorial material. This is an outro transition, not an ordinary territory frontier or replay.

replayFreezeAssessment.effectiveAnimationLengthPolicy: Do not claim an invented short effective length: all958 frames decoded, no qualifying freeze or opening/end loop. Slow map holds and individual unit holds remain possible; global frame change is not proof every map layer moves.
